notes.title: Devlog #3 ٩(˶˃ ᵕ ˂˶ )੭ .ˊˎ-✧| 12.09.2025
notes.content:
˗ˏˋConnection reestablished. Downloading new data…ˎˊ˗
Hey, are you there?|˶˙ᵕ˙ )ﾉﾞ It's been a while and we have a lot to catch up on in this devlog!

For the past few months, we've been focused on creating a brand-new vertical slice: polishing minigames, designing platforming levels, adding new dialogues, visuals and even multiple endings! The result? Over an hour of polished, playtested gameplay that we'll be building upon until release! Let's go deeper! ◝(ᵔᗜᵔ)◜

 
1. ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆New Character & Midnight Hangout⋆ ☾ ﾟ｡⋆
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618646/44c677f38a39dd3c2069e956dc5296a527b260dd.png"]

Say hello to Bar Syberia, a neon-drenched location that only appears when the digital moon is high. It's the perfect place to unwind, dance and meet some strange new faces.


Like Cyra, a mysterious loner that might know a little too much about the world around... It's better to be on her good side, and she might just share her secrets. Or not.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618646/a7fb59d45b708f3999e4dc90908edb19e29bc8ea.gif"]







2. (❀ˆᴗˆ) Make & Break Friendships (•́ᴗ•̀✿)
Your choices matter more than ever! Every character now has a relationships metric that changes depending on your choices and actions. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618646/547d7ae3ac33f445173fa3624f3e45222d774df4.gif"]Answer a question wrong? Smash a window? Your loyal guide, Sparkles, will take a hit. But don't panic! Use your Fixer Tool to repair the damage, as long as you have recource... 

Your gifts may heal, increase relationships and solve problems, so be keen not to miss them laying around. 𐙚⋆°Ⰶ｡⋆♡

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618646/d05b3a45f7198f1b3c2aab2a98346121d64038db.png"]
3. ⋆｡𖦹° A Fish Story In My OS?!⋆｡˚ 𓆝
You read that right. Because what's a game without fishing?  Take out pieces of the pong window with a fish you need to catch it, complete fishing quests and collect bounties.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618646/a6e82f7a99dc134d89917defff080f21b1987407.png"]

Better yet, if you like a particular fish you can keep it as a pet on your desktop! Your new tamagotchi-like fish friend lives right on your OS. Name it, feed it, watch it poop... and yes, it can even be trained for a profession or meet a tragic end. Take good care of it!( ˘͈ ᵕ ˘͈♡)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618646/ae5fc8b39a70ed62d4c5b2f6bc98a2ae42fc8675.gif"]


4. 👾✮ ⋆˚｡𖦹 Minigames Overhaul: Break It Till You Make It ⋆｡°✩👾
All mingames were remade to better work with our core mechanic: window destruction and repair. Strategically breaking and fixing windows will now help you win more easily. This change makes every playthrough feel more creative, sandboxy, and rewarding. Think with portals, but with windows!

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618646/65f29e937a149caae9231333d26674f6430a0dd2.gif"]


5. ⋆⁺₊🎮⃟.˚⋆ GDWC 2025 Finalist: Most Promising Game! ⋆˚.⃟🎮₊⁺⋆
We're thrilled to share that sprkls.exe has been selected as a finalist for "Most Promising Game" at the Game Development World Championship!
This is a huge honor for our small team, and we're so grateful to everyone who has supported our glitchy digital world. Let's keep the momentum going!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618646/a94ff5475b3c60a4be986690067ef0974ca49c35.png"]


This is just the beginning. We're back on a regular dev schedule, so you can expect more frequent updates from now on! As always don't forget to follow PesiiDom on socials if you want to stay in touch with the development!  

 
The single best thing you can do is: 



 ADD SPRKLS.EXE TO YOUR STEAM WISHLIST (ㅅ´ ˘ `)  



It helps us IMMENSELY and ensures you don't miss the release. 
See You Soon!◝(ᵔᵕᵔ)◜

notes.title: Devlog #2 (´,,•ω•,,)♡ | 26.06.2025
notes.content:
Hey everyone! It's been a while since we've posted an update, but we have been working hard all this time! Here's a quick rundown of all we've accomplished last month:

1. New mechanic! Remember procedural windows destruction? From now on, when you destroy a window, you store its pixels as a resource which you can spend later to repair other windows! Certain windows will work only when repaired, others might disappear if you break them too much... 👾

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618646/92f4bd0198ab8ed9b64789ecb3a1de582a365c5c.gif"]

2. Another new feature! We added a fully working messenger in our game! Now different characters will randomly send you messages and publish posts on their personal pages. Not only will this make the digital world of SPRKLS.exe feel more alive, but your responses also affect your in-game relationships and advance the story further (´｡• ᵕ •｡)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618646/871ce080e0ca210817022284e45352e4312a857f.gif"]

3. Mirrors OS got an upgrade! Now you can open its File Explorer and get access to different system files to uncover its secrets... 🖥👻

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618646/713b3f3136778e8489e6f6af2ed9779dcc2b7f7a.gif"]4. New soundscape system implemented! Now you can open several locations simultaneously to construct your own unique soundscape 👻🎧



5. SPRKLS.exe is submitted for the Game Development World Championship!!! We also put together a new demo for this contest and we'll share bits and pieces from it on our socials!



6. Refined movement for the platforming sections. Platforming honestly feels much more snappy and responsive now compared to how it used to be ^_~☆

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618646/7b8287c2fa891031c6ebf2d4058c37e647caef91.gif"]



7. A bunch of new assets! The interface of our virtual desktop has been reworked, new landscapes for our locations, character portraits are now animated and relay different emotions. On top of that, all the windows in the game are functionally color-coded based on whether you can drag and destruct them (◕ω◕)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618646/01b84ca809a65e147264f13f64c8d1a77ff8f60b.png"]



8. We also ran a series of closed tests to gather feedback! Right now we work on expanding and redesigning platforming sections of SPRKLS.exe to have more variety in levels and gameplay.
As always we remind you to follow us everywhere (links in bio) to stay tuned and get more insight in development process ₊˚ʚ ᗢ₊˚✧ ﾟ.

notes.title: Devlog #1 (๑>◡
notes.content:
(*≧▽≦)ﾉｼ)) Hey everyone! ヾ(´∀｀)ﾉ

Here’s a little update on what we did last week!

1.  It’s been a week since our official announcement on Steam, hooray! We’ve been pretty active on all socials, promoting our trailer, making short-form content, and posting all sorts of sneak peeks on new features 👀 We’re at 4.2k views on YouTube and 1.2k views on TikTok after only a week of posting, which is incredibly motivating! There will be even more content in the near future, so make sure to follow us everywhere (o^^)o

[previewyoutube=N4FHTbbqOBQ;full][/previewyoutube]

2. We keep working on seamless transitions between different windows in the game! Traveling in and out of windows feels much more natural and smooth now, and our goal is to make it possible under any circumstances. This way, our main character will be able to get to places never explored before...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618646/f3ae6bd75e57d56c8852bfc9866875ab52ae71ea.gif

3. New feature! Right now we’re working on a procedural destruction system for the windows. We’ve got huge plans for this mechanic, which we’ll share in the future... But it looks hella cool already (★ω★)/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618646/82388500c75eb11dbb6f5931eb84a225379da4b4.gif

4. We’re almost done with implementing localization system into our game! SPRKLS.exe is translated into two languages already, and this will help us quickly switch between them, as well as add more languages in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618646/1444f078b70cd8f8b51791c5227bb06c4953c808.jpg
